Subject: Post-call: Next steps & pick a 30-minute preview slot

Hey Sam / Lina —

Thanks again for taking time this morning. Quick recap from our discovery:
- Primary goal: reduce inference latency for your real-time recommendations pipeline while keeping unit cost stable.
- Constraints: PCI-adjacent data flows, peak windows 10:00–14:00 ET, preference for reserved capacity with an emergency burst option.
- Success criteria for a 30-min preview: end-to-end demo of a small recommendation model (<=1B params) on similar traffic profile, and a short throughput/latency estimate for your 99th percentile.

Next step: a 30-minute product preview (demo + 10 minutes for Q&A) with our infra lead to validate the latency projection and a short ops checklist. Can you pick one of the following 30-minute windows next week? I tried to offer options that line up with your peak hours.

Option A: Tue 24 Jul — 11:00–11:30 ET
Option B: Wed 25 Jul — 12:30–13:00 ET
Option C: Thu 26 Jul — 10:30–11:00 ET

Attendees we recommend: your infra/eng owner (ops), one product/PM, and we’ll bring Neha (solutions engineer) + me. If you prefer a different day/time, reply with two alternatives and we’ll adapt.

I attached a short RFI snapshot we referenced in the call and a tentative calendar invite placeholder.

Best,

—Priyom
Priyom Das | Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Priyom —

Thanks for the recap and for pulling those options together. Good summary. A couple quick notes from our side:
- We can’t do anything earlier than 11:00 ET on Tue/Wed/Thu because of customer standups.
- Our infra lead (Lina) is out on Wed afternoon, so Option B would be risky.

If you had to prioritize, our preferred order is: C (Thu 10:30 ET) first, then A (Tue 11:00 ET). I can join either and will loop in our infra engineer to confirm availability.

Also, can Neha include a very short slide (1–2) on how prefix caching would look for our streaming inference use case? Lina will want to see that in the session.
